thread:
Ashley: heads-up — deploybot failed to fetch the build artifact for this release window, staging promotion halted. saw a 403 from storage.
Deploybot: [bot] failed to fetch artifact 2983 from s3://redwood-artifacts/ci/2983.tar (403), retrying (3/3). full log: `GET /ci/2983.tar -> 403 AccessDenied`.
Ben: confirming, same 403 in our CI logs. curl against presigned URL returns 403.
Claire: is the pipeline supposed to fall back to the eu mirror? I thought we added mirror fallback last quarter.
Ben: mirror fallback exists but the pipeline change in PR #4512 removed the mirror config for this job (accidental). config shows `artifacts.mirrors: []`.
Ashley: for the release window we need a quick decision: rollback the code, or pin to an earlier successful artifact and promote manually?
DevOps: pin + manual promote is lower risk for GA. rollback of code will cascade into prod DB migration questions.
Mike: oncall here. I can run a manual promote to canary with artifact 2981 (the last green). I'll also verify migrations.
QA: hold smoke and key e2e until canary is promoted and we get green. We can run a short regression suite in parallel.
Ben: quick workaround I validated locally: `deploybot promote --artifact 2981 --env canary --manual` promotes fine. I can trigger if we agree.
Claire: long-term fix: restore mirror config and enable deploybot fallback. Also increase artifact cache TTL for upload-service; looks like a recent ACL change on the primary bucket caused the 403s.
Deploybot: manual promote triggered by Ben at 2923101460. Promoting artifact 2981 -> canary.
Mike: monitoring health checks now. `/api/health` 200/200 on canary instances.
QA: smoke tests: login, create, embed pipeline — all green on canary.
Ashley: OK, plan: 1) Hold GA release for the remainder of the change window, 2) pin GA to artifact 2981 and perform manual promote, 3) patch pipeline to re-enable mirrors and revert the accidental config removal, 4) include short blurb in release notes about promotion delay and root cause, 5) follow-up postmortem tomorrow.
Ben: opening PR to pin artifact for the GA job and add mirror fallback. I'll reference this thread and attach logs.
DevOps: I'll open infra ticket to revert bucket ACL change and add a guard in CI that validates presigned URLs before promote.
Ashley: also drafting the release notes entry and changelog. I'll add the operational mitigation steps.
Mike: I'll add a runbook snippet for manual `deploybot promote` and health-check checklist under ops-runbooks.
Claire: after we cut GA, let's schedule a short post-merge test to exercise the mirror fallback path (simple `curl` test against both primary and mirror).
Deploybot: artifact 2981 promoted to canary by Ben at 2923101602 :white_check_mark:.
QA: canary smoke still green at +12m.
Ashley: holding GA until 10:00 PT tomorrow to monitor - not rolling forward earlier. Draft release notes appended to PR #4921. Thanks all :tada:
Ben: PRs: #4921 (pin artifact + fallback), #4922 (validate presign pre-check). Links: https://repo.redwood/pulls/4921, https://repo.redwood/pulls/4922
DevOps: follow-up ops ticket: INF-987 to revert ACL and add CI guard.
Mike: tagging SRE to watch the canary overnight.
Ashley: ok closing thread for now. Ping here when PR merges or if any new 403s show up.
